findings.current: Over the course of roughly a day, Leviathan had completely absorbed the masses of magical power that humans called S-rank Magic Gems.
findings.defect: This makes the previously consumed S-rank Magic Gem plural, contradicting Chapters 751–752, which establish that Leviathan obtained and absorbed one unrefined S-rank Magic Gem.
findings.rationale: The singular preserves the established quantity and keeps the comparison with the later two-gem bait internally consistent.
findings.replacement: Over the course of roughly a day, Leviathan had completely absorbed the mass of magical power that humans called an S-rank Magic Gem.

summary: The packet is cohesive in voice, terminology, formatting, and active continuity. One localized quantity mismatch makes Leviathan’s previously consumed Magic Gem plural despite the surrounding chapters consistently establishing a single gem.
